gate.title: Gate
gate.description: Grants access to other parts of the tree.

gate_starter.title: Libra, Keeper of Justice
gate_starter.description:
Grants access to Libra's perks.
Free to allocate.
gate_starter.extra_description: The universe is a scale, and you are its fulcrum. Your every action, however good or bad, brings it closer to eternal balance.

gate_bootes.title: Boötes, Herdsman of the Void
gate_bootes.description:
Grants access to Boötes's perks.
Requires 3 allocated points!
gate_bootes.extra_description: His staff does not guide, it corrupts and commands what should not be.

gate_virgo.title: Virgo, Astromancer of the Realm
gate_virgo.description:
Grants access to Virgo's perks.
Requires 3 allocated points!
gate_virgo.extra_description: A crystalline prison that holds the essence of flame, forst, and storm in perfect order. Beautiful.

gate_hercules.title: Hercules, First and Last Titan
gate_hercules.description:
Grants access to Hercules's perks.
Requires 3 allocated points!
gate_hercules.extra_description: How far can a mere mortal go through sheer force of will? You know.

gate_orion.title: Orion, Huntsman of the Cosmos
gate_orion.description:
Grants access to Orion's perks.
Requires 3 allocated points!
gate_orion.extra_description: The hunt is not about power, but about the patience to wait and the resourcefulness to strike when all odds are against you.

gate_corona_borealis.title: Corona Borealis, Great Unifier
gate_corona_borealis.description: Grants access to Corona Borealis's perks.
gate_corona_borealis.extra_description: One doesn't mend what is broken, but forces it into perfect harmony.

gate_corona_australis.title: Corona Australis, Wreath of Thorns
gate_corona_australis.description: Grants access to Corona Australis's perks.
gate_corona_australis.extra_description: Greed is a hunger that can only be sated by taking from yourself and leaving others empty.

gate_microscopium.title: Microscopium, Observer's Eye
gate_microscopium.extra_description: To see beyond is to understand that the smallest truth can be a window to the largest secret.

gate_norma.title: Norma, Well of Abundance
gate_norma.extra_description: The power that lies within perhaps is what you'll need.

gate_crux.title: Crux, Anchor of Hope
gate_crux.extra_description: Life springs eternal from this light that sustains all it touches.

gate_scutum.title: Scutum, Defender's Wall
gate_scutum.extra_description: Not even Sloan's greatest creation can shake your will.

gate_fornax.title: Fornax, Heart of the Hearth
gate_fornax.extra_description: The fires of the cosmos are responsible for both creation and destruction of worlds.

gate_horologium.title: Horologium, Keeper of Time
gate_horologium.description: The universe doesn't care, moving in its own time. You simply learn to align yourself with its undisturbed pace.

gate_vulpecula.title: Vulpecula, Sly Survivor
gate_vulpecula.description: If you can't be strong or sturdy, be either fast or resourceful. Against all odds, you've learned to be both.

gate_sagitta.title: Sagitta, Swift Arrow
gate_sagitta.extra_description: A single, well-placed shot can bring down any foe.

gate_lacerta.title: Lacerta, Brittle Blade
gate_lacerta.extra_description: Power is only granted to those who are ready to let go of their lives.

gate_leo_minor.title: Leo Minor, Apex Predator
gate_leo_minor.description: Grants access to Leo Minor's perks.
gate_leo_minor.extra_description: Every battle needs not to be a long one. Sometimes, a clean strike is all it takes.

gate_pictor.title: Pictor, Unwritten Story
gate_pictor.description: You are not defined by what came before, but by the endless possibilities of what you will become.

gate_triangulum.title: Triangulum, First Horizon
gate_triangulum.extra_description: There's a great advantage in seeing all moves while making none yourself.

gate_triangulum_australe.title: Triangulum Australe, Last Horizon
gate_triangulum_australe.description: Grants access to Triangulum Australe's perks.
gate_triangulum_australe.extra_description: Where one world ends, another begins, rising from the ashes of all that was.

libra_notable_top.title: Althorian Skin
libra_notable_top.description:
You have +15% Spell Resistance
You gain 10% more Experience
libra_notable_top.extra_description: An innate defense of the first people to inhabit these lands.

libra_notable_right.title: Right Scales of Justice
libra_notable_right.description:
Roll Recharges 20% faster
You have +3% Dodge Chance
You have 10% more Maximum Mana
libra_notable_right.extra_description: Mobility is at a premium here. Best not to squander it.

libra_notable_left.title: Left Scales of Justice
libra_notable_left.description:
You have +2 Armor
You have +1 Armor Pierce
You have +1 Attack Damage
libra_notable_left.extra_description: Bonk anything with enough force and they will bend.

bootes_notable_top_a.title: Worthy of the Future
bootes_notable_top_a.description:
Your Spells' Cooldown Recover 19% faster
You have 5% more Spell Damage
You have 17% less Attack Speed
bootes_notable_top_a.extra_description: One hand gives, the other takes.

bootes_notable_top_b.title: Worthy of the Past
bootes_notable_top_b.description:
You have 17% increased Mana Regeneration
Your Spells Cast 29% faster
Your have 5% more Spell Power
You have 13% less Movement Speed
bootes_notable_top_b.extra_description: One hand takes, the other gives.

bootes_notable_arm.title: A Lesson in Profanity
bootes_notable_arm.description:
You have +13% Eldritch, Blood, Ender, Nature, and Evocation Spell Power
You have -23% to Holy and Fire Spell Resistance
bootes_notable_arm.extra_description: Fuck! Fuck! Shit! Cunt! Bitch! Oh, not this kind of profanity?

bootes_notable_right_foot.title: Pierce the Veil
bootes_notable_right_foot.extra_description: Why would his foot give me night vision? Well whatever.

virgo_notable_head.title: Elemental Ascension
virgo_notable_head.description: You have +10% Fire, Ice, and Lightning Spell Power
virgo_notable_head.extra_description: The only three officially recognized elements by a fops.

virgo_notable_left_hand.title: Touch of Celerity
virgo_notable_left_hand.description:
Your Spells Cast 20% faster
You have +1 Armor
virgo_notable_left_hand.extra_description: And one point of armor there for good measure.

virgo_notable_right_hand.title: Touch of Haste
virgo_notable_right_hand.description:
Your Spells' Cooldown Recharge 20% faster
You have +8% to Spell Resist

virgo_notable_left_foot.title: Arcane Warding
virgo_notable_left_foot.description: You have +20% Soul Ward Capacity and it Recovers 15% faster
virgo_notable_left_foot.extra_description: A fops legitimately has no idea what these are for!

virgo_notable_right_foot.title: Arcane Agility
virgo_notable_right_foot.description:
You have +3% to Dodge Chance
You have 10% increased Mana Regeneration

hercules_notable_left_arm.title: Conditioning
hercules_notable_left_arm.description: You have 10% more Maximum Health, Armor, and Armor Toughness
hercules_notable_left_arm.extra_description: And to think some people workout at the library.

hercules_notable_right_arm.title: A Strong Arm
hercules_notable_right_arm.description:
Your Attacks Pierce +2 Armor
You have 20% more Critical Damage
You have 40% less Spell Power
hercules_notable_right_arm.extra_description: Why is one arm always stronger than the other?

hercules_notable_right_foot.title: Herculean Feats
hercules_notable_right_foot.description:
Your Jumps are 20% Stronger
You have +25% to Ice Resistance
You have +1 Armor Toughness
hercules_notable_right_foot.extra_description: I have no idea what I'm doing anymore. These puns are BAD, BAD.

hercules_notable_left_foot.title: Dexterous Maneuvers
hercules_notable_left_foot.description:
Your Rolls Go 40% Further
Your Rolls Recharge 35% Slower
You have 8% more Attack Speed
hercules_notable_left_foot.extra_description: Why is it a sushi roll? Oh.

orion_notable_hand.title: Straight from the 133 Labs
orion_notable_hand.description:
You have +0.75m to Entity Interaction Range
You have 20% less Spell Power
You have 20% less Attack Damage

orion_notable_belt.title: Alnilam, Mintaka, and Alnitak
orion_notable_belt.description:
You have +1 to Fortune and Looting
You have 25% more Mining Speed
orion_notable_belt.extra_description: Respectively: string of pearls, the belt, the belt. Yep, that's what Orion's Belt is composed of.

orion_notable_bow_top.title: Skypiercer
orion_notable_bow_top.description:
Your Projectiles Deal 10% increased Damage
You have 25% increased Drawing Speed
orion_notable_bow_top.extra_description: Provided you're using a (cross)bow for some reason, it should be good.

orion_notable_bow_bottom.title: The Stargazer Conspiracy
orion_notable_bow_bottom.description:
Your Critical Strike Chance is increased to 35%
You have 50% less Drawing Speed
You have 30% less Attack and Casting Speed
orion_notable_bow_bottom.extra_description: This name doesn't even make sense?

orion_notable_foot.title: Lightfooted
orion_notable_foot.description: Blocks that Slow Movement do so at 50% Effectiveness
orion_notable_foot.extra_description: A fops would probably wager the opposite is best. If you know that he means, of course.

norma_notable.title: Wellspring of Creation
norma_notable.description:
Your Maximum Mana is tripled, but Mana Regeneration is halved
You have 4% more Spell Power
norma_notable.extra_description: Yep, this is where I took *that* name from.

microscopium_notable_left.title: Artifice and Scavenging
microscopium_notable_left.description: You have +1 to Spirit Spoils and Looting
microscopium_notable_left.extra_description: You can never have enough loot when mobs barely spawn.

microscopium_notable_right.title: Please Check Malum's Guidebook on Removing a Geas Pact, tyvm!
microscopium_notable_right.description:
You have +1 to Maximum Geas,
but You have 20% less Maximum Health

vulpecula_notable_mid.title: To Survive in the Wilds...
vulpecula_notable_mid.description:
You are Immune to Poison and Slowing Effects
You have Permanent Vulpine Grace 4
You have Permanent Sundering 2
vulpecula_notable_mid.extra_description: Each level of Sundering increases damage taken by 20% by the way. Foxes really are dumb creatures after all.

vulpecula_notable_end.title: ... and Thrive, perhaps?
vulpecula_notable_end.description:
You have 60% less Gravity
Swimming and Sneaking are significantly faster
You have +2 to Maximum Rolls
Your Rolls Recharge 200% faster
Your Rolls Go 1 Block Shorter
You have +0.5 to Step Assist Height
You are Immune to Fall Damage
You have Permanent Weakness 1 and Speed 1
You have 40% less Spell Power
vulpecula_notable_end.extra_description: Floatiness and speed are why Pathfinder was designed back in the Dark Week. So was Vulpecula in New Horizon. And because I'm a fops. And because sweet berries are sweet indeed. Anyway.

horologium_notable_mid.title: Just in Time!
horologium_notable_mid.description:
Your Spells' Cooldown Recharge 50% faster
Your Rolls Recharge 20% faster
You have 20% reduced Spell Power
horologium_notable_mid.extra_description: Did you know 'more' is multiplicative with other modifiers and 'increased' is additive? The same for 'less' and 'reduced.' Thanks, Path of Exile.

horologium_notable_end.title: An Instrument for Telling the Hour
horologium_notable_end.description:
Your Spells Cast 25% faster
You have Permanent Hastened 1 and Weakness 1

corona_a_notable_top.title: eptitranxisticemestionscers descending
corona_a_notable_top.description:
Your Summons deal 30% more Damage
Your Knockback Resistance is zero
You have Permanent Grievous Wounds 1
corona_a_notable_top.extra_description: Get a free stack of Bedrock by pronouncing the first word correctly by the 11th of September!

corona_a_notable_bottom.title: pittor pickgown in khatheinstersper
corona_a_notable_bottom.description:
Your Attacks deal +4 Cold Damage
You have +60% to Fire Resistance
You have +1 Armor Toughness
You have Permanent Slowed 1
corona_a_notable_bottom.extra_description:
Afflict them with that which afflicts you.

Psst: try searching for these names on Google, will you?

corona_b_notable_left.title: Wicked World
corona_b_notable_left.extra_description: And I thought Malum didn't have spells. Huh.

corona_b_notable_right.title: Elemental Attunement
corona_b_notable_right.description: Attune Yourself with one of the Elemental Powers
corona_b_notable_right.extra_description: I wanted to make more of these, but I'm already procrastinating my irl shit to do these.

corona_b_choose_1.title: The Molten Path
corona_b_choose_1.description:
Your Fire Spells Deal 8% more Damage
You have +20% to Fire Resistance
Your Other Elemental Spells Deal 30% less Damage
You have 40% reduced Spell Resistance against Other Elements
corona_b_choose_1.extra_description: You love the heat, but can you take it?

corona_b_choose_2.title: The Frigid Path
corona_b_choose_2.description:
Your Ice Spells Deal 8% more Damage
You have +20% to Ice Resistance
Your Other Elemental Spells Deal 30% less Damage
You have 40% reduced Spell Resistance against Other Elements
corona_b_choose_2.extra_description: The Winds of Winter are supposedly coming.

corona_b_choose_3.title: The Stormy Path
corona_b_choose_3.description:
Your Lightning Spells Deal 8% more Damage
You have +20% to Lightning Resistance
Your Other Elemental Spells Deal 30% less Damage
You have 40% reduced Spell Resistance against Other Elements
corona_b_choose_3.extra_description: Throw shit up in the air enough times and eventually shit is bound to stick here shit must.

crux_notable_common.title: Mending Splinters
crux_notable_common.description:
You have Permanent Regeneration 1
You have +10% to Blood, Eldritch, and Ender Spell Resistance
Your Summons deal zero Damage
crux_notable_common.extra_description: Kind of whatever, but still not that bad?

crux_notable_top.title: Focus, Strength, and Faith
crux_notable_top.description:
You have 25% more Holy Spell Power
You cannot Move while Casting
crux_notable_top.extra_description: I find your lack of faith disturbing.

crux_notable_bottom.title: Enlightenment
crux_notable_bottom.description:
You gain 60% more Experience
You cannot be Blinded
crux_notable_bottom.extra_description: We went on a Crusade the last time someone like this got to power. Not again, please?

scutum_notable_top.title: Spell Doom
scutum_notable_top.description:
You have 40% more Spell Resist
You have 70% less Spell Damage
You cannot be Knocked Back
You cannot wield ranged weapons
scutum_notable_top.extra_description: No one is enjoying my puns anymore, so why do they keep coming?

scutum_notable_bottom.title: Built Different
scutum_notable_bottom.description:
You have Permanent Resistance 1
You have Permanent Slowness 1
You are Permanently Outfoxed
You cannot Roll
scutum_notable_bottom.extra_description: Slow and steady wins the fight, I guess.

fornax_notable.title: Heart of the Furnace
fornax_notable.description:
Your Attacks deal +3 Fire Damage
You have +60% to Ice Resistance
You have Permanent Fire Resistance 1
fornax_notable.extra_description: You're hot to the touch-- uwu

leo_notable.title: Ambush and Assassinate
leo_notable.description:
Your Attacks deal an Additional 8% of the Target's Current HP as Additional Physical Damage
You have 10% more Attack Damage
You have 10% more Attack Speed
Your Rolls Recharge 50% faster
You have 30% less Armor and Armor Toughness
leo_notable.extra_description: It's the only place you'll ever get the first stat from. At least until I change my mind!

lacerta_notable_right.title: Certain Strike
lacerta_notable_right.description:
You have 100% Critical Chance
You have 35% less Spell Power
You have 35% less Projectile Damage
lacerta_notable_right.extra_description: I wonder what's your plan... if any?

lacerta_notable_left.title: Dissolution of Flesh
lacerta_notable_left.description:
Your Attacks Shred 60% of Armor
You have 70% less Armor and Armor Toughness
You have 40% less Spell Resist
lacerta_notable_left.extra_description: You might see your bed a few times more than everyone else.

sagitta_notable_top.title: Touch of Poison
sagitta_notable_top.description:
You have Permanent Aspect of the Spider 4
You have 15% more Nature Spell Power
You have +50% to Nature Spell Resistance
sagitta_notable_top.extra_description: One hundred and thirteen times a second, nothing answers and it reaches out.

sagitta_notable_bottom.title: Deadeye
sagitta_notable_bottom.description:
You may only Deal Damage with Bow and Crossbow Projectiles
You have 100% more Draw Speed
You have 20% more Projectile Damage
sagitta_notable_bottom.extra_description: You better know how to aim.

tri_a_notable_1.title: Nimble
tri_a_notable_1.extra_description: Entropy always catches up to you.

tri_a_notable_2.title: Deft
tri_a_notable_2.extra_description: Make the world spin around you.

tri_notable_1.title: A Life of Leisure
tri_notable_1.description: You have +2 to Fishing Speed and Luck

tri_notable_2.title: Lucky Scratch
tri_notable_2.extra_description: Some people are just born with the gift.
